RULE-MEAL-TIER1.name: Daily Meal Allowance (Tier 1 Metro)
RULE-MEAL-TIER1.description: Daily meals capped at ₹2,000 for Tier 1 cities (Mumbai, Delhi, Bangalore). Partial reimbursement permitted.

RULE-MEAL-TIER2.name: Daily Meal Allowance (Tier 2/3 Cities)
RULE-MEAL-TIER2.description: Daily meals capped at ₹1,500 for Tier 2/3 cities (Pune, Hyderabad, Jaipur, etc.).

RULE-HOTEL-CAP.name: Nightly Hotel Accommodation Cap
RULE-HOTEL-CAP.description: Standard accommodation capped at ₹5,000/night for Tier 1, ₹3,500/night for Tier 2.

RULE-CAB-LOCAL.name: Local Transit & Cab Fare Limit
RULE-CAB-LOCAL.description: Intra-city transport, taxi, and airport transfers allowed up to ₹1,500 per journey.

RULE-CLIENT-MEAL.name: Client Meal Compliance & Headcount
RULE-CLIENT-MEAL.description: Requires mandatory Client Name, Company, Business Purpose, and Attendee Count. Max ₹3,500/head.

RULE-PROHIBITED-GOODS.name: Prohibited & Non-Reimbursable Purchases
RULE-PROHIBITED-GOODS.description: Alcohol, tobacco, personal gifts, spa services, and gaming are strictly non-reimbursable.

RULE-APPROVAL-TIER.name: High-Value VP Approval Threshold
RULE-APPROVAL-TIER.description: Any single expense claim exceeding ₹5,000 must be approved by Vice President or Department Head.
